server_verification.answer: The existing restored-token0x100c8f20 producer sends held token/session fields to music.login.LoginServer.Login; cached credential presence alone is not verification. New refresh and Authorize producers do real shared-transport handoffs but have distinct purposes and response rules.
server_verification.required_success: For adapter login/restore, await successful transport and requested RPC result code0, then validate returned native session fields before committing loggedIn. Request dispatch returns0 by itself is not server acceptance.
server_verification.bounded_search: Only refresh/Authorize/LoginServer literals in this Protocol image and exact linked entries were surveyed. No independent ValidateLogin/VerifyLogin producer was proved. This does not assert its absence from the whole application.
